# Reason picker — M3 guidance

<!-- Generated by apps/site/scripts/one-off/migrate-guidance.mjs. Do not edit by hand.
     The component pages carry the reference; this file carries the guidance. -->

## Web

### Features

Reach for the reason picker when the flow needs a why: the generic reason selector over an injected data adapter. `reasons` is the required adapter — reason rows plus context — so one picker serves cancellation, decline and every other reason context, and rows derive from the adapter on every render, so the announced set is always the current context's set. The picker owns no reasons in any context and there is no local copy — only the injected rows render — and there is no mode prop either, because reason picking is option-list semantics with the mode fixed rather than hidden. Single-select closes on pick while `multiple` with multi-select reporting collects several and stays open, and every other prop is the picker contract, with date, plan and country modes available around the fixed option-list core. Reasons render through the picker option contract as a listbox of options with selected state, named by label alone.

## Native

### Features

Reach for the reason picker when the flow needs a why: the generic reason selector over an injected data adapter — the native twin under the same contract. `reasons` is the required adapter — reason rows plus context — so one picker serves cancellation, decline and every other reason context, and rows derive from the adapter on every render, so the announced set is always the current context's set. The picker owns no reasons in any context and there is no local copy — only the injected rows render — and there is no mode prop either, because reason picking is option-list semantics with the mode fixed rather than hidden. Single-select closes on pick while `multiple` with multi-select reporting collects several and stays open, and every other prop is the picker contract, with date, plan and country modes available around the fixed option-list core. Reasons render through the picker option contract with checked state, named by label alone.
